comments.author: @TravelBeyond4K
comments.text: That wall of green at the Darién Gap is incredibly daunting. You can feel the intense humidity and raw isolation just looking at that impenetrable rainforest where the world's longest highway simply vanishes into mud and thick jungle. Nature truly holds the upper hand in this part of Central America!
